cases.query: Can I cancel my order?
cases.answer:
Whether you can cancel your order depends on its current status. 

According to the Cancellation & Service Credit SOP v4:
- If the order is BOOKED but not yet PICKED_UP, you may cancel it. There is no fee if cancelled within 30 minutes of booking; after 30 minutes, a fee of INR 250 applies. 
- If the order has already been PICKED_UP, it cannot be cancelled; you must use the return-to-origin workflow instead. 
- If the order has been DELIVERED, it cannot be cancelled.

Please provide your order ID so I can check the specific status and eligibility for your order.
